title: Max Difference You Can Get From Changing An Integer
description: Find the maximum difference between the max and min possible integer values obtained by changing exactly one digit in num.
pseudocode:
1. s = num.toString().split('')
2. max_val = findMax(s)
3. min_val = findMin(s)
4. return max_val - min_val

steps.note: Initialize string array from input number 555
To maximize, replace the first non-9 digit with 9
To minimize, if first digit is > 1, replace all instances with 1; otherwise replace first non-0 non-1 with 0
